note: City of Arlington campground in Nordland Park, on the north side of Lake Arlington (a small town pond with Nordland Isle) at Hwys 14 & 81: five camper pads plus a free grassy tent area. Non-electric spots are free; the $10 charge is for electricity. Nearest dump station is at the city's Maxwell Park campground downtown. --Claude
